Cleaning business owners & future cleaning business owners! 🧹🔥

If you’re serious about starting, growing, or scaling your cleaning business, you need to get around people who are actually doing it.

We’ll be in the building October 8th & 9th at the CBN Conference! 💎

Come learn, network, make connections and get in the room with other cleaning business owners.

👇🏾 Comment “CBN” below and I’ll send you the link to grab your ticket!
items.transcript:
Step 1, get your LLC. Step 2, get your EIN. Step 3, open a business bank account. Step 4, tell your cousin, now you can't be late every damn day. Step 5, get some business cards. Step 6, build a website. Step 7, stop using your damn cash app as your business account. Oh, hell no. Step 8, get some customers. Step 9, don't charge Ms. Johnson $40 to clean a 5,000 square foot house. You're going to be broke by Wednesday. Step 10, hire somebody that actually likes to clean, not your cousin Ray Ray. You still need AI. You still need employees. You still need sales. You still got about 97 more steps. That's why October 8th and 9th, Jacksonville, Florida, hundreds of cleaning business owners, learning, networking, laughing, building businesses, and probably complain about employees together.
So here's your last instruction. Quit watching YouTube University. Book your damn ticket. October 8th and 9th, we'll see you in Jacksonville. Don't be the one talking about, I should have went.

items.caption:
That job you hate does NOT have to be your forever.

If you wake up every morning dreading going to work, watching the clock, feeling underpaid, overlooked, and knowing deep down you want MORE…

**A cleaning business could become your EXIT PLAN.**

And no, I’m not telling you to walk into work tomorrow and quit.

I’m telling you to **BUILD YOUR WAY OUT.**

Start your cleaning business while you still have your paycheck.

Learn how to price.
Learn how to get clients.
Go after recurring contracts.
Build your systems.
Hire the right people.
Stack your revenue.

Then work toward the day when your business income gives you the OPTION to leave that job.

I built a cleaning company that generated over **$2 MILLION in revenue in 5 years.**

I made mistakes.
I lost money.
I learned some expensive lessons.

But I also learned what it takes to build a real cleaning business.

So if you're sitting at work thinking…

**“I KNOW I wasn't put on this earth just to clock in here every day.”**

Stop just dreaming about leaving.

**Start building your exit plan.**

If you're serious about starting or growing your cleaning business and you want to see how we can help you inside Tenacity Academy…

👇🏾 **COMMENT “DISCOVERY CALL” BELOW.**

We’ll reach out to you with the next steps.

**Your job might be paying the bills today.
Your business could be building your freedom tomorrow.**

Not just any commercial accounts. Five-day-a-week, seven-day-a-week preferably. And if you don't know what type of accounts that would be, use good old ChatGPT. Two, I would build a Dream 100 list. It's really, really cool. So if you guys are interested, meet me on the other side. www.tenacityacademy.com. I'll see you on the other side.

items.caption:
Does this sound like YOU? LOL

You want the freedom.
You want the money.
You want to call yourself a CEO.

But you don't want to hire.
You don't want to train.
You don't want to follow up.
You don't want to learn your numbers.
You don't want to sell.

At some point, we have to tell the truth:

You don't get CEO results while avoiding CEO responsibilities.

Did we take it too far… or did somebody need to hear this? 👀

You don't want to answer repetitive customer calls. You don't want to train new virtual assistants. You don't want to deal with cancellations. You don't want to deal with the admin work. You don't want to find no new leads. You don't want to follow up. You don't want to run no ads on Facebook and Instagram. You don't want to post on social media.
